summary.text: Tom Willis is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 15, listed with Berkeley County; the district covers Hampshire and Morgan counties and part of Berkeley. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Willis' page lists his education as the University of Virginia and Georgetown Law, and his occupation as West Virginia business owner and National Guardsman.
It gives his birthplace as Martinsville, Virginia, names his spouse as Sara Willis, and lists three children.
His affiliations include the Special Forces Association, the National Guard Association and the Eagle Scout Association, along with several Republican clubs.
Willis also serves on the Senate's Health and Human Resources, Interstate Cooperation, Military and Pensions committees.
